scope: Fix media repair errors, support base64 input, enforce camelCase API naming, and adopt fluent useSlide context

tasks.title: Fix PowerPoint Repair Errors in Generated Media PPTX
tasks.description: Investigate and resolve presentation repair errors produced after running showcase/media_advanced.js. Ensure [Content_Types].xml includes valid overrides for all embedded media types (audio, video, image formats). Ensure correct relationship mapping in ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels with standard OpenXML type schemas and clean up orphaned relationship IDs and timing tree nodes upon media removal.

tasks.title: Fix Audio, Video, and Image Mutation & Deletion Lifecycle
tasks.description: Fix update and removal logic for media elements: (1) Ensure source swapping for images and videos properly updates ppt/media/ binaries and relationship references. (2) Fix video element fetching and ensure removeVideo correctly removes <p:pic> / <p:spTree> nodes, related <p:timing> sequences, and relationship bindings. (3) Ensure updateAudio, updateVideo, and updateImage update position, bounds (<a:xfrm>), and playback attributes without crashing or leaving stale attributes.

tasks.title: Enable Base64 Ingestion Support Across All Media Loaders
tasks.description: Allow addImage, updateImage, addVideo, updateVideo, addAudio, and updateAudio to accept base64-encoded strings directly (both raw base64 and data URI schemes like data:image/png;base64,... or data:video/mp4;base64,...). Decode strings into in-memory Buffers before persisting to ppt/media/ and registering content types.

tasks.title: Enforce CamelCase Function Naming Across Media Subsystem
tasks.description: Audit all exported functions and internal delegates to ensure strict camelCase compliance: addImage, updateImage, removeImage, addVideo, updateVideo, removeVideo, addAudio, updateAudio, removeAudio, getMedias, getMedia, and cloneMedia. Update PPTXTemplater class method delegates, index.d.ts, and test fixtures accordingly.

tasks.title: Contextualize Slide Operations to useSlide() & Make slideId Optional
tasks.description: Refactor media methods so slideId/slideRef is derived from the active context set by ppt.useSlide(slideNumber). Make slideId purely optional across signatures (e.g. ppt.useSlide(1).addImage(source, options)), while safely falling back to the active slide or an optional explicit parameter for backward compatibility.

tasks.title: Update showcase/media_advanced.js, Documentation & Verification
tasks.description: Rewrite showcase/media_advanced.js to demonstrate all repaired functions using camelCase and ppt.useSlide(n) contextual chaining with file paths, base64 data URIs, and Buffers. Verify the generated output opens in Microsoft PowerPoint without triggering repair prompts. Run unit and integration tests and update documentation.
